script_name: Outbound Pitch with Vehicle REG (My Reclaim / Law Room)
rules: Introduction: Agent must give their name and identify as calling from "My Reclaim".
Purpose of Call: Must explain the call relates to the FCA's car finance redress scheme / a potential mis-sold car finance claim.
Prior Claim Check: Must ask whether the customer has already received money back for a PCP claim or signed up to receive money back from the FCA scheme.
No Win No Fee (word for word): Must state "Law Room works on a no win no fee basis". If the customer asks about fees, the agent must say 15-30% plus VAT; any other fee figure is a FAIL.

Right to DIY (word for word): Must read the Law Room statement that the customer does not need to use a claims management company or law firm to claim, and ask "are you happy for us to do this for you?" receiving a yes or positive answer.
Law Room Contact Notice: Must tell the customer that Law Room may reach out in the coming days with updates or a quick welcome call.
Multiple Claims Warning (word for word): Must warn that submitting multiple claims could mean paying multiple firms' fees and ending up with nothing.
Questions and Close: Must ask if the customer has any questions and state that Law Room will be in touch via calls and email.
